00049 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00050 {
00051 public:
00052     BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00053     BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw();
00054     BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();
00055     ~BufferChannelInternal() throw();
00056     
00057     inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00058     inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() 
00059     { 
00060         const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00061         unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00062         if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00063             iIndex1 = 0;
00064         const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00065         const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00066         
00067         return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point        
00068     }
00069     
00070     friend class Buffer;
00071     friend class PartBuffer;
00072     friend class ComplexBuffer;
00073     
00074 private:
00075     float* data;
00076     unsigned int size_;
00077     unsigned int allocatedSize;
00078     
00079     BufferChannelInternal (const BufferChannelInternal&);
00080     const BufferChannelInternal& operator= (const BufferChannelInternal&);
00081 };

00299     template<class NumericalType>
00300     inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00301     {
00302         NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00303         
00304         if(channels != 0)
00305         {
00306             int channelToUse = channel;
00307             while(channelToUse < 0)
00308                 channelToUse += numChannels_;
00309             
00310             NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00311                                                                                 channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00312                                                                                 false);
00313             array = floatArray;
00314         }
00315         
00316         return array;
00317     }
